game_concept: A survival strategy set in Eldritch Ruins – Ritual Pool, a still ritual pool: the tomb cartographer must handle echo phantoms while practicing lists. Core idea – Comprehension Lab: Build new lists in one line with list comprehensions to transform ancient keys.
theme: Eldritch Ruins – Ritual Pool: a still ritual pool
core_gameplay_loop: In Ritual Pool, repeat each round: Build new lists in one line with list comprehensions to transform ancient keys. Each round, echo phantoms strike the glyph door, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the lab_output value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Bonus coins for fast correct moves
player_objective: Protect the glyph door from echo phantoms in Ritual Pool: keep the lab_output meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 30-second timer ends.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
lose_condition: lab_output drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 30-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 7 – Lists | Level 1 (intro tier): Comprehension Lab
assets_style: mysterious pixel-art ruins: mossy stone pillars, overgrown arches, faint eldritch glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; eerie choir pads and stone-scrape stings
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Comprehension Lab' (Week 7 slot 11), mission type 'Survival Siege', and setting 'Ritual Pool'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Eldritch Ruins
region.mood: eerie choir pads and stone-scrape stings

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how lab_output changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against echo phantoms in Ritual Pool.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 30 seconds while lab_output > 0.
